description:
## Dual VoT Patches 1.37.0-dev.1-dualvot.4

### Configurable Yandex countdown

- Adds an animated progress ring to the Yandex player button.
- Shows the estimated remaining time inside or below the icon, or hides the text.
- Adds settings for ring visibility, color, and thickness.
- Switches to an indeterminate animation when Yandex exceeds its estimate.
- Shows a short red animated signal for request or playback errors.
- Updates the bottom-sheet status immediately when translated audio starts.
- Fixes Android resource packaging for the countdown placement list.

### Included base

- Based on stable Morphe Patches 1.37.0.
- Test pre-release; enable pre-release patches for this source in Morphe Manager.
